notes: curated: lt.json#pensionagefemale | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: 64.66 from 2025-01-01 | IMPOSSIBLE today — official pension age for women in 2025: 64 years 8 months, i.e. 64.66 in EUROMOD's decimal convention. The statute states a STEP SCHEDULE (+4 months per year, reaching 65 in 2026), not the per-year value: the pipeline must derive the cohort value from the schedule and convert months to a decimal — derivation-not-extraction, plus a representation-convention trap (64.66 vs 64.67 vs 64+8/12). Pin the exact article/annex of the pension-age schedule when drafting. ROUTING: EUROMOD already carries the 2025 value, so a correct pipeline routes `unchanged` — it must re-confirm the value with a citation, not propose a change. The 2024->2025 movement described above is still what the value and citation legs test.
